canonical_grid_version: docs/CANONICAL_GRID.md, 992 cells, 1.0deg (locked, guarded as of Phase 4.5)

predictor_sources.cin: UNAVAILABLE -- no real source in this repo
predictor_sources.ctt_c: UNAVAILABLE -- no historical archive, only live current snapshot
predictor_sources.pan_india_scope: NONE of the above predictors have a real historical pan-India archive; data/pan_india_grid.json is a live snapshot only

label_sources.ts: VOBL METAR/station observation (data/actual_log.csv lineage) -- VOBL cell only, 991/992 cells UNKNOWN
label_sources.cb: IMD 0.25deg gridded daily rainfall (imd_rain/rain/*.grd), threshold 64.5mm/day -- genuinely pan-India
label_sources.ff_observed: 0 rows in THIS built dataset: no observed flash-flood label was joined into processed/dataset/*. IndoFloods inputs now exist in the repo (see indofloods_inputs) but are not wired into this partition build, and the CWC gauge flood events they contain are river-gauge events, not validated flash-flood labels.
label_sources.ff_proxy: rainfall-only proxy (3-day cumsum>=100mm AND daily>=40mm), kept in ff_proxy_* fields, never written to ff_label

source_resolution.panindia_cb_partition: daily, 0.25deg IMD source regridded to 1.0deg canonical cells

panindia_cb_partition.all_12_predictors: 100% missing for every row -- no historical pan-India predictor archive exists

git_commit_if_available: a7d54dd8e5ed4b505e342c1b5342c1998c93e5ac (base commit the original Phase 5 dataset build ran on; the build scripts were committed later)
reproducibility_note: Regenerate exactly via: python3 scripts/build_panindia_dataset.py (from repo root, with imd_rain/rain/*.grd and data/era5_6hrly_bengaluru_2015_2025.csv present). Deterministic -- no random sampling or seeded process is used anywhere in construction.

indofloods_inputs.status: present in repo; NOT joined into the partitions described above (manifest not regenerated)

catchment_characteristics.meaning: static morphometric/catchment attributes per CWC gauge; contain NO event labels and NO time dimension

gauge_metadata.meaning: gauge identity, location, river/basin, record dates, warning/danger levels

observed_events.meaning: observed CWC gauge flood events (level/discharge based). Evidence of river floods at gauges only; not flash-flood labels, not hourly, not rainfall-attributed

indofloods_inputs.line_ending_note: these files are hash-pinned by tests/test_indofloods_phase5.py; .gitattributes marks them -text so bytes are preserved
